classification: Normative design/acceptance examples; not execution outputs or a public persistence format.
action_words: Table notation only; no compatibility detector or public enum is implemented.

cases.change: Exact verified bindings and effective request are unchanged
cases.reason: Exact existing plan/runtime comparisons still apply.

cases.change: Only an external artifact locator changes; bytes and provider mappings are verified equal
cases.reason: Location verification is explicit; paths already inside old declarations are not rewritten.

cases.change: Only presentation or dated stock metadata outside the scientific binding changes
cases.reason: Availability is not molecular identity or a structural refresh.

cases.change: Prepared coordinates change under the same display name
cases.reason: Use a new verified prepared parent and captured feature evidence.

cases.change: Topology, protonation/stereo state or conformer identity changes with similar coordinates
cases.reason: Molecular correspondence and preparation belong to MolSysMT.

cases.change: Local atom or geometry-participant mapping changes
cases.reason: Equal centers and feature kinds cannot recover original atom identity.

cases.change: Source occurrence keys, multiplicity or encounter order change with equal payloads
cases.reason: Payload sharing needs explicit verified maps; no silent renumbering.

cases.change: An extra family is requested and returns no features
cases.reason: Requested/evaluated-empty differs from unrequested or unknown.

cases.change: Raw family ordering/duplicates change, with the same qualified effective set
cases.reason: Preserve output feature order; current serialized declarations remain authoritative.

cases.change: The feature/perception definition changes under familiar family names
cases.reason: Names alone do not identify recognition or geometry semantics.

cases.change: A donor direction, aromatic normal or charge changes
cases.reason: Position-only postings are not silently rebound to a new feature parent.

cases.change: An explicitly converted encoding changes units while preserving verified physical values
cases.reason: Retain both byte identities and the public quantity conversion; do not infer equal hashes.

cases.change: The coordinate/frame/PBC convention changes
cases.reason: Use supported provider transformations and preserve correspondence.

cases.change: Candidate implementation or numerical admission changes with the same method family name
cases.reason: The177source correction and original receipts supply the concrete distinction.

cases.change: Query/tolerance changes within an explicitly qualified retrieval domain
cases.reason: A reusable upstream asset does not make a saved run resumable with new query bytes.

cases.change: Scoring, grouping, ordering or execution budget changes with the retrieval predicate unchanged
cases.reason: Effective settings and completion/selected-witness meanings remain in the new plan.

cases.change: Optional/alternative feature semantics or a numerical scale lack retrieval qualification
cases.reason: No implicit fallback, dropped constraint or invented negative.

cases.change: Bin width, precision, chirality or asset representation changes
cases.reason: New asset qualification is separate from feature extraction.

cases.change: A complete explicitly requested family is evaluated empty
cases.reason: An empty feature family does not classify arbitrary queries or biological activity.

cases.change: Parent/request/coverage context is missing or unverified
cases.reason: A matching opaque ID is not verification of the prepared source.

cases.change: A payload is corrupt or uses an unsupported schema
cases.reason: Preserve the failure; do not manufacture an empty successful extraction.

cases.change: A query returns a budget-limited candidate prefix
cases.reason: Unsearched bins/occurrences remain unknown and confirmed outcomes remain original.

cases.change: A replacement build fails, cancels or is only partial
cases.reason: Older data require explicit compatible selection; do not publish the failed replacement as current.

cases.change: A historical run has index=None and original six compatibility declarations
cases.reason: No retrospective migration, added metadata, scientific credit or changed reader semantics.
